name: IP address and device matching
plain: Sites and ad vendors link visits and devices by shared IP address and basic device traits.
meaning: A visit's IP reveals city level location and the ISP; matched with user agent and time it joins phone and laptop on the same Wi-Fi into one household. Needs no cookie; breaks with VPN, Private Relay or mobile CGNAT.

web.api: TCP source address; X-Forwarded-For; WebRTC (blocked mDNS)

access.persistence: Per request; vendors retain logs for weeks to years
access.revocation: Clear site data, browser privacy settings

limits.headline: Can link visits and devices that share your network address and basic device traits
limits.user_action: Nothing. It happens whenever you visit a site or load an ad
can: Tell which visits come from the same network
Link devices that share a home or office address
Use device traits like browser and screen size to refine the match
cannot: Pin down your exact home address, only an approximate area
Tell people on the same network apart for sure
Work well if you use a VPN or a private relay
Follow you when your address changes, though traits may still match
limits.differs: iPhone Private Relay and VPNs hide the real address.

story.what_it_is: Sites and ad firms link your visits and devices by their shared IP address.
story.for_you: You never see it. Every site you visit sees your IP address, which shows your city and internet provider. Your phone and laptop on the same Wi-Fi can look like one household.
story.for_makers: IP needs no cookie and no consent box. Matched with device clues, it links phone and laptop. A VPN, Private Relay or shared mobile network can break the link.

use_cases.example: An ad system shows a TV ad on your phone after you searched on your laptop on the same Wi-Fi.
A site counts a visit by city and internet provider, with no cookie at all.
A bank flags a login from a new country or a known VPN address and asks for extra proof.
A multiplayer web game matches you with nearby players, and bans cheaters by IP.
A streaming site blocks videos by country, using the IP to place you.
A shop shows prices in your currency and local stores, based on IP.

technical_bounds: Shared by many people behind NAT
iCloud Private Relay and VPNs hide it
City level accuracy typically 70 to 95% depending on database

legit_uses: Geo content, fraud detection, rate limits

history.change: iCloud Private Relay launched for paid iCloud users
